declaration_count_semantics: Frozen C1 lexical observations are not elaborated declaration or theorem counts
premise_review: CategoricalBridgeEquivalence contains two supplied categories, two opposite-direction functors, exact object equalities for both composites, and HomEquivalence evidence for both functors. It does not construct those data.

object_injective uses logicObjectRoundTrip as a left inverse; object_surjective uses knowledgeObjectRoundTrip as a right inverse; object_bijective packages those exact conditional conclusions. These are strict equalities of objects, not merely isomorphism classes.

morphism_injective and morphism_surjective retain B, A/C, f/g and use only the imported HomEquivalence lemmas on B.toKnowledgeHomEquivalence. No exact historical dependency-provider identity is inferred from the declaration name.

unitIsoHash, counitIsoHash and the topos/site/semantic-preservation strings supply no natural transformations, naturality proofs, triangle equations or constructed topos. No inverse equivalence on morphisms is produced by these source commands.
LayerCategories has five abstract category labels and eight supplied adjacent forward/reverse functors. Four receipt hashes and claimBearing remain metadata, not mathematical laws.

LayerObjectRoundTrips supplies all eight adjacent exact object equalities. LayerHomRoundTrips supplies HomEquivalence for all eight directed functors. Those are premises of the LayerCategoryEquivalence record, including fields not used by the final object-bijection proofs; no assumption is removed.

logicToWisdom and wisdomToLogic construct four-hop object and hom maps and discharge map_id/map_comp by the supplied constituent functor laws. No composite HomEquivalence or inverse functor identities on morphisms are constructed.

The two endpoint round-trip theorems require an explicit E and use its supplied adjacent object equalities in the stated order. The final bijectivity proof uses those two results and no kernelStatus/visualAuthority/claimBearing truth hypothesis.

kernelStatus, visualAuthority and claimBearing are unconstrained Bool fields, with no true-value assumption in any theorem. No execution, kernel check, semantic-preservation verification or authority follows from their presence or labels.
No proof/type/field body was rewritten. All named source commands and complete namespace/import context remain exact archives; no receipt/authority record is installed as a maintained Math component.
